limitations: Every call and interval is retained; no sample exclusion or acceptance threshold.
Disk traffic is system-wide and includes benchmark loading.
CPU rates are observed lower bounds when processes appear, disappear or cannot be read. Short-lived work can be missed.
The controller and Docker clients outside the benchmark cgroup remain in other-process activity.
GPU flags describe other devices, not process attribution. Unknown counters are not zero.
An interval can overlap multiple calls; endpoint coverage does not remove gaps or establish causality.
The last candidate call in each bundle ends after the last monitor sample; endpoint coverage is incomplete.
CPU observations include lower bounds for appeared/disappeared processes. Disk activity includes model loading. No sample was dropped.
GPU activity counters are samples and cannot exclude short activity between samples.
